    page-layout: full

```{r}
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| label: setup

source("vis_init.R")
gws = readRDS("data/cbb_gwsDaily.RDS")
gwsHeader = read_sf("data/cbb_gwsHeader.gpkg")





```




```{r}
#| label: Interactive Map
#| echo: false
#| warning: false
#| message: false
#| width: 100%
#| height: 1500pt



bg_shading = data.frame(
  
  xmin=lubridate::quarter(gws$Datum, type = "date_first") |> unique(),
  xmax=lubridate::quarter(gws$Datum, type = "date_last") |> unique(),
  ymin=-Inf,
  ymax=Inf
)
bg_shading$fill = rep(c("grey80", 'white'), length.out = nrow(bg_shading), each = 1)



p = lapply(gwsHeader$ID, function(x){

  gws |> filter(ID == x) |> 
    
  ggplot(aes(x = Datum, y = GWS_rel))+
  geom_rect(data = bg_shading, mapping = aes(xmin = xmin, xmax = xmax, ymin = ymin, ymax = ymax, fill = fill), inherit.aes=FALSE, show.legend = FALSE, alpha = 0.5)+
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("white" = "white", "grey80" = "grey80"))+
  geom_point(size = 1, color = "royalblue")+
  geom_line(color = "royalblue2")+
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0)+
  scale_x_date(name = NULL, date_breaks = 'year', date_labels = '%y')+
  ggtitle(paste0("GWS relativ [cm]; Sensor ", x))+
  scale_y_continuous(name = NULL)+
  gg_theme_report+
  theme(plot.margin=grid::unit(c(5,5,5,5), "mm"), panel.grid.major.x = element_line(linetype = "dashed"))


})


mapviewOptions(basemaps = c("OpenTopoMap"), leafletHeight = 1000)
mapview(gwsHeader, popup = popupGraph(p, width = 500, height = 300), legend = FALSE, zcol = "ID", col.regions = "black", color = "white")



```
